lines.zh: 我一颠一颠地走，身上有东西在动。
lines.en: I walk in fits, something moving under my hide.

lines.zh: 我跟着其他感染的，一起走。
lines.en: I walk with the other infected.
The mycelium snaps under my hooves.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，可一直在走。
lines.en: I'm slow, but I never stop.

lines.zh: 我绕开一丛发亮的东西。
lines.en: I go round a glowing clump.

lines.zh: 我的鼻子抽动，闻个不停。
我拖着后腿，走得一歪一歪。
lines.en: I drag a hind leg, walking crooked.

lines.zh: 我在这片菌林里转来转去。

lines.en: I walk over what's on the ground.

lines.zh: 我一步一步，往更深处去。

lines.en: My call has changed. It isn't a pig's.

lines.zh: 我站着，身上的东西在鼓。
lines.en: I stand. Something on me swells.
It doesn't itch much. Or hurt.
I lower my head and chew twice.
The colors in this wood are wrong.

lines.zh: 同一片菌地上，我们一群。
lines.en: On this mycelium we are a herd.

lines.zh: 我打了个喷嚏，喷出点东西。
lines.en: I sneeze and something comes out.

lines.zh: 那东西在地上动了一下。
lines.en: It moves once on the ground.
I look at it a while.
Something grows on the tail too.

lines.zh: 尾巴上有东西，我不管它。
lines.en: Something on my tail. I leave it be.
Standing in the fungus. I'm waiting.
You're standing behind the fungal growth.

lines.zh: 不太一样，是外面的味道。
我的眼睛有一边不太行。
lines.en: One of my eyes doesn't work well.

lines.zh: 我一边眼睛不太好，可我看得见你。
lines.en: One of my eyes is bad, but I still see you.

lines.zh: 我往前挪了一步，盯着你。
lines.en: I shuffle one step closer, watching you.
You stepped back a few paces.
I stop and look at you.
Only that I need to get close.
A piece of me fell off. Still moving.
It hurts. I still know what hurt is.

lines.zh: 旁边的也叫了，声音很低。

lines.en: I pull back behind the fungal growth.
I lift my head. My neck is heavy.
I lean in and sniff — rot and mud.

lines.zh: 我用鼻子把它推到一旁。
lines.en: I nose it off to one side.
The mycelium will spread to it.
You bumped me and I swayed twice.

lines.zh: 我身上的东西掉了一点。
lines.en: A little of me dropped off.
It's still moving on the ground.

lines.zh: 我绕开你，鼻子还在拱土。
lines.en: I go around you, still rooting at the dirt.
I don't think about that much.
Those beside me are like me.
What's on us grows and grows.
By then, you'll be the same.
I nudge it with my snout.
I pick it up and walk two steps.
It fell. I don't pick it up.
I walk over what's on the ground.
In a few days it rots. Fine.
I smell it and lift my snout.
Fungal growth blocks me. I go round.
My companions raised their heads too.
I only sped up a little.

lines.zh: 我一直跟着，腐肉味散不掉。
lines.en: I keep following; the rotten flesh smell will not wash off.
Not fast, but I don't stop.
You've backed to the fungal growth.

lines.zh: 我身上有东西在动，跟着我跑。
lines.en: Something moves under my hide, and it runs with me.
No need to run. I walk slowly.
Slower, and I'll still get there.
I drive my head into it.

lines.zh: 我咬的这一口，牙不算利。
lines.en: This bite of mine. My teeth aren't sharp.
But once I bite, I don't let go.
Two more snort up behind me.
Several of us. It can't break free.

lines.zh: 我身上有东西，碰到就沾上。
lines.en: What's on me sticks to whatever it touches.
After you get home, it'll itch.
I push out of the fungal growth.
A layer of white threads clings to me.
The soil in this wood is soft.
I go forward, step by step.

lines.zh: 菌在林子里长得到处都是。
lines.en: Fungus grows everywhere in this wood.
There are more of us there.

lines.zh: 火一燎，菌丝卷起来，有味道。
lines.en: Fire touched me. The threads curled, smelling.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下去，身上散了些。
lines.en: I rolled down the slope and scattered a little.

lines.zh: 水灌进来，我浮了一下又沉。
lines.en: Water poured in. I rose once and sank.

lines.zh: 震得我身上的东西都抖下来。
lines.en: The blast shook off what was growing on me.

lines.zh: 那光一照，菌丝缩回去了。
lines.en: That light made the threads retract.
I can't get it down. I'm thinning.
